brenas_note: v13 review 1 (owner request): the whole Brenas region was re-partitioned (roads/relief aware, nothing across the Rizia/Zille border, clear shapes around Marbelas 64). Brenas ids 40-50 and 52-67 were re-assigned to the new cells by largest overlap with the previous v13 cells, so the same id now covers a similar but NOT identical area (see share_of_v13/share_of_v12). Mave Nortus 23 is unchanged from v13; Dapalle 51 was enlarged (city-shaped, ~5x the area). No Brenas id was added or removed.
note: share_of_v13 = part of the v13 province covered by the v12 province; share_of_v12 = part of the v12 province that went into the v13 province. Shares <2% are omitted (borders/gaps moved slightly).
